nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: According to Giuseppe De Ruvo, what is the misconception regarding the objectivity of algorithms?
nodes.answer: The misconception is that algorithms are objective tools that produce infallible results, whereas in reality, they can be misleading and perform imperfect calculations depending on the complexity of the context.
